title: analyze
description: Measure a video over time, in buckets. timing reads packets only: frame durations, duplicate timestamps, gaps (frames missing), keyframes, Mb/s, vfr, and pictures coded as repeats. motion decodes: the change from frame to frame (0 to 255) and cuts. audio: peak and RMS dBFS, clipped samples, silences. Out of time, it returns the buckets done with complete false and next_from to call again from. Moments come back exact, to send to look.

from.description: A time, as look's: the start by default.

to.description: A time: the end by default.

stream.description: Its index in probe's full report: the first video stream, or audio for audio, by default.
